sections.heading: MAJOR IN CRIMINOLOGY
lines: Completion of first-year requirements including Sociology 1020, Sociology 1020W/X or Sociology 1021E with a mark of at least 60%.
2.0 courses: Sociology 2205A/B and Sociology 2206A/B, Sociology 2240E or Sociology 2270A/B and Sociology 2271A/B.
